sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A platform fight with edges you can fall off, an escalating oil-management problem, and a support NPC (Saul) whose ward is a hard requirement past 75%. 12-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Demonic Tears (from 75%)
bullets: Tears spawn around the platform every 15 seconds — close one by walking into it. Each player has a 1-minute cooldown after closing a tear, so spread the duty across the squad.
The projectiles tears fire can't be blocked and ignore protection — don't rely on defensives to sit in one.

sections.heading: Annihilate ("pizza")
bullets: Roughly every 20 seconds Deimos smashes his flails down, sending a cascading knockback around the arena from front to back — telegraphed by an orange segmented circle.

Dodge toward the boss's front, or stay within a single segment, to avoid the damage (you'll still get knocked back either way). A block reduces damage but doesn't stop the knockback — mind the platform edge.

sections.heading: Mind Crush & Saul's ward
bullets: Roughly every 40 seconds, Mind Crush targets everyone on the platform — after a 5-second channel, anyone hit is instantly downed.
Saul drops a protective dome at the center that blocks it — get inside. Outside the dome (even blocking) still takes 70% max HP over 10 seconds.

During the oil phase, tank Deimos away from center rather than on top of it — oils target whoever's closest to Deimos besides the tank, and keeping the boss off-center keeps Saul's ward accessible to everyone else.

sections.heading: Oils (from 60%)
bullets: Oils spawn on the closest non-tank player to Deimos, telegraphed by orange circles that expand over 30 seconds — new ones spawn every 15 seconds. A fully expanded oil is generally a wipe, so pop it or move the fight before that happens.
At 25%, Drunkard Saul shows up — break his bar quickly, or he'll randomly teleport players, sometimes straight into an oil.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 12:00 — Deimos deals +200% damage past this point.
